scope: Character counts only; the original printable scope is unchanged and no omission is authorized

letter_body.rule: Remove delivery heading and its following blank line only

body_without_sources_tails_and_partI_sou.rule: Remove inline SOURCES marker/tails to each line end; remove Part I source-list block up to, but not including, the Part II heading; join preceding paragraph and Part II by two newlines

body_without_backtick_source_labels_only.rule: Delete only each complete backtick-delimited eq:/sec:/app: label token; preserve all remaining spaces and punctuation
